units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 42:8">Targ. Ps. XLII, 8</cite>; a. fr.—

Taan. 25ᵇ I saw Ridia (v. רִידְיָא) וקיימא בין ת׳ תתאה לת׳ עילאה … standing between the lower depth (of the earth), and the upper depth (of the heavens); לת׳ עילאה וכ׳ to the upper t’hom he said, distil thy waters; to the lower depth he said, let thy waters spring forth.
<cite ref="Onkelos Exodus 15:5">Targ. Ex. XV, 5</cite>; <cite ref="Onkelos Exodus 15:8">8</cite>; a. fr.
